name: Speed of Limb Movement
definition: The ability to quickly move the arms and legs.

benchmark.name: World Humanoid Robot Games 100m sprint
benchmark.model_or_system: Tiangong Ultra (Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center)
benchmark.metric: seconds (100m finish time; lower is better)
benchmark.human_reference: General working-age adults (the typical person who needs to move limbs quickly in work settings, e.g. manual, service or safety roles). Neither trained sprinters nor elite athletes.

benchmark.name: World Humanoid Robot Games
benchmark.model_or_system: Tiangong Ultra (Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center)
benchmark.metric: seconds (100 m sprint time; lower is better)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce. Speed of Limb Movement is a basic physical ability used across manual and physical occupations. Elite sprinters are the ceiling of that population.
